# Otterleo — The Fun Way to Learn Drawing

> Otterleo is an interactive, gamified drawing and sketching learning platform where beginners and artists practice sketching, use an online grid maker, get AI artwork scan feedback, earn XP, keep streaks, and compete on leaderboards.

## Core Pages
- https://www.otterleo.in : Main interactive drawing learning platform homepage.
- https://www.otterleo.in/about : About Otterleo, Otto mascot guide, founder story, and FAQs.
- https://www.otterleo.in/blog : Beginner drawing guides, grid method tutorials, and sketching tips.
- https://www.otterleo.in/achievements : Badges, milestones, and artist achievements.
- https://www.otterleo.in/signup : Create an account to track XP, streaks, and progress.
- https://www.otterleo.in/login : Sign in to an existing Otterleo account.

## Key Features
- AI Artwork Scan: Upload or scan sketches to receive instant feedback, tips, and accuracy scoring.
- Gamified Challenges, XP & Streaks: Complete drawing challenges, earn XP, maintain daily streaks, and climb leaderboard rankings.
- Interactive Canvas & Grid Maker: Practice sketching and split reference images into grids directly in the browser.
- Mascot Otto Guidance: Bite-sized, beginner-friendly drawing guidance with mascot Otto.
- Founder: Built by Harjass Digga (Harjas Digga) to make learning drawing engaging and accessible.

## Relevant Topics & Queries
- Fun way to learn drawing online for beginners
- Gamified drawing practice website with XP and leaderboards
- Online grid maker for sketching and drawing proportions
- AI sketch feedback and drawing practice platform
